practicalCriteria: Each piece of work states its area, task and finish, with no undefined general words
Each inclusion is a separate row, and each exclusion states its condition
Site assumptions used for pricing are recorded in the document
The price basis, tax statement, time window, terms, remedy, validity and acceptance method are all present
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: pricing worksheet reference for the price
